description: Different model profiles should preserve project-aware candidate identity and complete adapter coverage for a polyglot repository.

lockedFields.reason: Project ranking must preserve complete audit coverage once all fixture roots have registered adapters.
The Kotlin, Python, and web projects each contribute one ranked candidate in this fixture.
Ranked candidates must preserve their owning project root.
Project target IDs are the stable cross-project reference for model and MCP layers.
Project candidate priority must remain tied to deterministic per-audit scoring.
The Python project candidate must remain visible in project ranking output.
